Enter Experiment Info

Enter Gene Information

Type the gene you fused with GFP — its standard name (e.g. ACS1) or systematic name (e.g. YAL054C) both work. Each gene is checked by PCR across the 3′ junction of the insertion, using that gene’s own check primer plus the common F2CHK primer. A wild-type parent is always included as the negative control; a positive control is optional.
